pull.q: Converts a stereo modular signal to line level on a single 1U tile.

quotes.t: Stereo in on 3.5mm, stereo out at line level, one level knob.
Intellijel 1U format — it fits Intellijel cases and 1U rows, not Pulp Logic ones. This is the earlier model, which Intellijel have since replaced.

reviews.title: Stereo Line Out 1U — the manufacturer's page
Intellijel Stereo Line Out 1U — specs and racks

blurb.en: Stereo modular signal in, stereo line level out, one knob — on a 1U tile, so it lives in the top row of an Intellijel case and costs no 3U space. 8HP, Intellijel 1U format, which does not fit Pulp Logic rows. This is the legacy model; Intellijel have a newer one.
blurb.fi: Stereo modulaarisignaali sisään, stereo linjataso ulos, yksi nuppi — 1U-tiilenä, joten se asuu Intellijel-kotelon ylärivissä eikä vie 3U-tilaa. 8HP, Intellijelin 1U-formaatti, joka ei sovi Pulp Logic -riveihin. Tämä on vanhempi malli; Intellijelillä on uudempi.
blurb.sv: Stereo modularsignal in, stereo linjenivå ut, en ratt — på en 1U-bricka, så den bor i toppraden på en Intellijel-låda och tar ingen 3U-plats. 8HP, Intellijels 1U-format, som inte passar Pulp Logic-rader. Detta är den äldre modellen; Intellijel har en nyare.
